# retroBITE

> A clean, self-hosted collection manager for retro games. Pair your ROMs with rich metadata and artwork, then serve your library over the local network directly to your devices.

retroBITE (retrobite.app) is free, MIT licensed, self-hosted software that runs in Docker. It is in active development; the Docker image ships with the first public release.

## Docs


## Project

- [Activity](https://retrobite.app/activity): Development activity for retroBITE: commits per week and per day over the past year, lines changed and contributors.
- [Roadmap](https://retrobite.app/roadmap): What's shipped in retroBITE and what's planned next: disc image conversion, transfers and global search are in, with a BIOS archive, housekeeping and the public Docker release still to come.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/retroBITE-app/retroBITE): Source repository
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/frgN7y6x5T): Community server
- [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/u/retrobite): Docker images
